representations.name: dyadic prime reservoir
representations.new_information: uses the full population of primes in (X,2X) instead of one prime per expanding Bertrand interval
representations.first_test: show pi(2X)-pi(X)>2 floor(K/4) for X=b^(floor(K/2)-A) and all sufficiently large K

representations.name: Bertrand-only reservoir comparator
representations.new_information: tests whether one-prime existence alone can certify linearly many labels without expanding the interval
representations.first_test: derive a lower bound for the number of primes in one fixed dyadic interval from Bertrand alone

representations.name: constant-reserve exponent budget
representations.new_information: converts q_i<4X^2 into a K-independent reserve of at least 2A-2 base-b exponents
representations.first_test: compare this reserve with the five-unit balancing decrement at s=floor(K/4)

representations.name: A=3 boundary comparator
representations.new_information: tests whether the same worst-case constants still guarantee nonnegative padding one factor closer to sqrt(N)
representations.first_test: subtract the maximum five-unit decrement from the four-unit guaranteed reserve

representations.name: connected edge-prime path kernel
representations.new_information: represents every signed subrelation by z_(i-1)+z_i=0 along a connected path
representations.first_test: prove that only the zero vector and full alternating vector survive

representations.name: square-root internal-product comparator
representations.new_information: measures the minimum rough value at an internal degree-two vertex
representations.first_test: multiply two edge labels greater than sqrt(N)

representations.name: seedwise zero-query transcript
representations.new_information: retains only the primes queried after repeated zero valuations and allows arbitrary off-zero behavior
representations.first_test: embed the square-root-scale path entirely in one retain-labelled zero transcript

representations.name: shared-seed expectation charge
representations.new_information: charges zero-leaf deletion population seedwise and then averages without vertex independence
representations.first_test: replay the exact inequality Pr(success)<=E|D|/(L-t) with the new cutoff

representations.name: all-branch query union comparator
representations.new_information: tracks every prime appearing anywhere in the tree instead of only the realized zero branch
representations.first_test: place arbitrarily large primes on unreachable nonzero branches and test whether they affect the witness

representations.name: zero-population density boundary
representations.new_information: separates the exact L-dependent inequality from its positive-density o(N) corollary
representations.first_test: let L=o(N) and determine whether expected o(N) cost still implies vanishing success

representations.name: global repair comparator
representations.new_information: adds one post-classification deletion chosen after a missed path is discovered
representations.first_test: hit the displayed path at unit cost

representations.name: per-input randomized program comparator
representations.new_information: uses a separate program or fresh private coins for every integer
representations.first_test: check whether conditioning produces one uniform zero transcript
